narrative: Material PL1__M514C1DF exhibits moderate, continuously positive demand (mean 988 units/day, CV 0.32) with no detectable trend across the 93-day working-day history. Lead times are highly unstable (CV 0.79, range 0.03–3.82 days), making lead-time variance the dominant driver of safety stock. An (r,Q) continuous-review policy is recommended: reorder at 2,591 units and replenish 4,975 units each cycle, yielding a 6-day review cadence well within the 9,895-unit storage limit.

research_insights.selection_rationale: Demand is continuous and moderately variable with normal approximation; EOQ drives an economically optimal batch size well above MOQ=132. Continuous review is appropriate given the short but volatile lead time, allowing timely response to stock drawdowns.
research_insights.boundary_risk: No capacity constraint binds (SS + OQ = 6,485 vs. limit 9,895). Risk is on the service side: if lead-time CV worsens further, the 95% target may require re-evaluation of safety stock upward.
